reviews.title: This AIO kept my 5900x at 30C under heavy gaming!
reviews.comment: OMG this cooler is worth every penny. I’ve played a few games with it so far: Apex Legends, Genshin Impact, Satisfactory all with ultra high 4K settings, and this cooler kept my 5900X at 30C the whole time. The 5900X is notoriously hard to cool. Super easy install. I have an XL case that is built with AIO Coolers in mind. If you have a spare 397mm you’re good. Zero noise that I’ve noticed. I love the ascetics and the TRCC app to customize the display. I didn’t go crazy yet with my design, but one could really get creative with it.
reviews.author: KASABS

reviews.comment: I have bought countless aios from thermalright,  they all work great for almost any build, now with lcd for a fraction of the price.
